metadata.title: Dry Fish Chutney | Assamese Style
metadata.description:
This easy to prepare and delicious  Assamese style dry fish chutney makes a great side dish especially with rice and dal. 

This is an authentic dry fish chutney served in hundreds of roadside resturants also know as dhaba in the Assamese platter.  Learn to make this simple and easy yet mouthwatering delicacy at home.
